principle: ONE exam-run page cannot serve both a real Konkur sitting and a Mimo practice lesson. Four separate page models are selected by the exam kind.
method: CODE_FIRST / decoded APK layouts + Mimo section-practice grammar + real Konkur structure; screenshots VISUAL_CROSSCHECK_ONLY

emblem.before: ic_mimo_mascot (Mimo mascot) in both exam-hub and exam-result heroes
emblem.after_hub: ic_survey.xml — the APK's real quiz illustration (quiz_introduction_fragment.xml iv_quiz_introduction, 180dp)
emblem.after_result: ic_cap.xml — graduation cap, white on button_primary circle
emblem.note: both are decoded APK vectors; no Mimo mascot branding left in the exam surfaces

konkur.title: زمان خالص کنکور
konkur.for: آزمون جامع کنکور، زماندار، سرعتی، پومودورو، جمع بندی، نهایی
body: chapter_toolbar 52dp: X | title + 6dp progress + mode badge | timer | flag
INLINE Konkur answer sheet: 20 numbered bubbles (done / current / flagged), click to jump
quick 4-option bubble row (Mimo section-practice sp-opts grammar) — records the answer, never grades it
quiet tool chips: پاسخبرگ / پاسخنامه (policy) / AI / اتمام / تایمر / خروج
konkur.footer: Mimo interaction keyboard: 48dp «سؤال قبل» square | FULL-WIDTH purple «سؤال بعد» CTA | 48dp علامتگذاری square + «رد کردن سؤال» link
konkur.why: Konkur never reveals correctness during the exam; the answer sheet is filled while solving; 270 min is fixed; prev/next/mark/skip ARE the primary navigation; پاسخنامه is published after the exam

practice.title: تمرین میمو
practice.for: تکدرسی، مبحثی، این ماه، مرور غلطها، آزمون دوباره
body: tool chips with پاسخبرگ + پاسخنامه + AI
practice.footer: exact lesson_interactive: 48dp prev + 48dp bookmark + ONE full-width purple CTA that toggles lesson_submit «بررسی پاسخ» -> feedback -> lesson_continue «ادامه»; lesson_skip link
practice.why: learning mode, immediate feedback is the point (the user: «در آزمونهای تحلیلی شاید بررسی پاسخ مهم باشه»)

analytical.title: تحلیلی
analytical.for: تحلیل زیست، تحلیل آزمون جامع، تحلیل غلطها
body: INLINE تحلیل زنده card: درصد / اگر غلطها نزده میذاشتی / نقشهٔ ضعف / میانگین زمان
analytical.footer: 48dp prev | full-width «بررسی پاسخ» CTA | 48dp next + تحلیل toggle
analytical.why: analytical exams need BOTH immediate checking and free navigation + live stats

descriptive.title: تشریحی
descriptive.for: آزمون تشریحی (section ۷ template: تعویض سوال / تصحیح دستی)
body: NO 4 option cards — a written-answer textarea with a word counter
descriptive.footer: 48dp prev | full-width «ثبت پاسخ» CTA | 48dp next + «تعویض سوال» / «تصحیح دستی» chips
descriptive.why: a descriptive answer cannot be graded by a 4-way choice widget

reviewer_control: aside.spec > .modelpick — 4 buttons preview each model without changing the exam cards
unchanged_contract: 5 tabs / no MAX / original curved zigzag
7 labelled exam sections + templates + descriptive answer
one AI button in two places
v12 single full-width CTA grammar (per model)
